goal: Prevent existing block data from being overwritten or truncated during file allocation
Fix broken reindexing and chain data corruption on BSD, illumos, and Windows systems
reviewability: Author is currently reworking the implementation in draft to address design feedback
agreement: Nonblocking objection: prefer check in LoadGenesisBlock over low-level allocator patches (sedited)
Author agreed to add the check while advocating to keep allocator fixes as a backstop
Implementation nits raised on indentation and integer widening (thomasbuilds)

categories.name: utils
why: P1 because it fixes chain data corruption where reindexing overwrites existing block files with zeros
Directly benefits node operators running on platforms lacking posix fallocate such as BSDs and OmniOS
Prevents potential file truncation issues when allocating existing files on Windows
